synthesis.paragraph: Four of today's papers carry the tag "Urban Green Space and Health," covering topics such as estimating Tokyo window view desirability using 3D model imagery, reviewing visual research on heritage landscapes, integrating relational values and multispecies justice into urban treescape management, and a publisher correction regarding the diversity of urban street trees. Outside of this group, one paper combines morphometric descriptors with social media data to model socio-functional urban identity and neighborhood structure. Another study models and compares land surface temperature and the universal thermal climate index across Singapore to reveal the nonlinear effects of urban morphology on heat stress. Finally, a third paper constructs seasonal mediation models in Wuhan to analyze how impervious surface landscape metrics influence PM2.5 concentrations.
